﻿metadata:
  udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.manifest
  name: PrismataLabs Capability Manifest
  version: 0.4.0
  kind: capability-manifest
  description: >
    Declares all capabilities used by PrismataLabs for previewing,
    validating, selecting, loading, and configuring UI components.

capabilities:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Preview Capabilities
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.preview-object
    name: Preview Object
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: preview_object
    description: Render a preview of the selected object using Python preview engine.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: selected.object is not None

  - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.validate-preview
    name: Validate Preview
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: validate_preview
    description: Validate the selected object using canonical schema rules.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: selected.object is not None

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Selection & Loading Capabilities
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.select-load
    name: Select & Load Objects
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: select_load_objects
    description: >
      Select colour-schemes, border-patterns, panes, menus, menu-items,
      or ui-frameworks using the shared path_helper module.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Configuration Capabilities
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.default-folders
    name: Configure Default Folder Paths
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: configure_default_folders
    description: Configure default search paths for previewable objects.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Lifecycle
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - udi: prismata.prismatalabs.capability.app-quit
    name: Quit Application
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: exit
    executeTarget: exit_application
    description: Exit PrismataLabs.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Example Fixture Capabilities (for deterministic schema-validated demos)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.print-hello
    name: Print Hello
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_print_hello
    description: Example capability for single-pane hello output.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.clear-hello
    name: Clear Hello
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_clear_hello
    description: Example capability to clear hello output.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.exit
    name: Example Exit
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: exit
    executeTarget: example_exit
    description: Example capability for exiting demo flows.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.open-alt-pane
    name: Open Alternate Pane
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_open_alt_pane
    description: Example capability for activating alternate pane focus.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.print-left
    name: Print Left
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_print_left
    description: Example capability to print to the left pane.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.print-right
    name: Print Right
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_print_right
    description: Example capability to print to the right pane.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.switch-pane
    name: Switch Active Pane
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_switch_pane
    description: Example capability to switch active pane focus.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.clear-target-pane
    name: Clear Target Pane
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_clear_target_pane
    description: Example capability to clear currently targeted pane output.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.rotate-colour-role
    name: Rotate Colour Role
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_rotate_colour_role
    description: Example capability for colour role rotation in diagnostics.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled

  - udi: prismata.examples.capability.diagnostic-print
    name: Diagnostic Print
    kind: capability
    version: 0.4.0
    action: execute
    executeTarget: example_diagnostic_print
    description: Example capability for diagnostic pane output.
    visibilityMode: static
    enableMode: enabled
